testCases.name: Positive: Successful B2B registration creates ERP account, Ship-To address, inactive customer, mapping, and redirects to review page
Positive: Valid submission with alternate Type of Business and Contact Media combination
Negative: Missing required field blocks submission — no ERP/customer entities created
Edge: Rapid double-click on Create Account does not create duplicate entities
Positive: All Company Info fields accepted across different Type of Business dropdown options
Negative: Empty Company Name blocks submission with validation error
Negative: Invalid email format blocks submission with validation error
Boundary: BD phone number — valid 11-digit accepted, 10-digit and 12-digit rejected
Edge: Special characters and Unicode in Company Name handled without breaking the form
Boundary: Zip Code empty vs whitespace-only input
Positive: Selecting WhatsApp reveals required WhatsApp Number field, Messenger fields hidden
Positive: Selecting Messenger reveals required Messenger Account Name/Link fields, WhatsApp field hidden
Edge: Toggling Contact Media from WhatsApp to Messenger clears the WhatsApp Number field/value
Negative: WhatsApp selected but WhatsApp Number left blank blocks submission
Positive: Valid Username, Password, Confirm Password, dropdown, and business textarea accepted
Negative: Password and Confirm Password mismatch blocks submission
Boundary: Empty Password field blocks submission
Edge: Username containing special characters or spaces
Positive: All 3 required checkboxes checked (ToS, Privacy Policy, 18+) allows submission — Wholesale Agreement is display text, not a checkbox
Negative: Terms of Service unchecked blocks submission
Edge: Only the 18+ Age confirmation unchecked (others checked) blocks submission with specific error
Positive: Brand-new unique email and username pass the uniqueness check
Negative: Duplicate email (already-registered wholesale account) blocks submission with clear error
Negative: Duplicate username blocks submission with clear error
Edge: Case-variant duplicate email (e.g. UserKBD@gmail.com vs userKBD@gmail.com)
Positive: Admin sees full submitted wholesale data in Advanced B2B/B2C > Registration Applications
Edge: Registration Applications list correctly excludes/shows entries with no matching application, no crash
Positive: Admin activates account via Active flag + save — login enabled and welcome email sent
Negative: Login attempt before admin approval is blocked / inactive-account message shown
Edge: Admin deactivates a previously-active account — login blocked again
